verdict.rationale: A visual infrastructure canvas is a fair capability to ask of a serverless deployment platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents code- and CLI-driven configuration (Wrangler, bindings via code) and a dashboard used for rollbacks. Nothing shows a visual canvas for viewing or editing the whole stack without config files.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files
